findings.issue: The hero photo still has its own lettering printed into it ('…Sunlit Days', 'and summer-ready prints', and 'Shop Swimwear' / 'Explore the Collection' pills), which shows through behind our H1, lead and button. The hero reads as two overlapping layers of text, with dead buttons under the live one (reported before; unchanged in these shots).
findings.reference: The competitor's hero photo is a clean shot with no lettering. The only text on it is the live eyebrow, title, lead and two buttons.
findings.fix: Give /custom-swimwear-printing/ a hero photo with no lettering in it. Take the lettered photo out of the photo pool until it is regenerated without the text.

findings.issue: The related section has about twice the space of its neighbours: about 86px from its top edge to the heading and about 86px under the link row, against about 45px in the testimonials and FAQ sections around it (on phones about 70px against about 35px). The result is an unexplained empty band above and below a short row of links. This partly undoes the last repair's `.block--related { padding-block: var(--section-space); }`, which was meant for a related section on a tinted band; here it stands on white and doubles the gap.
findings.reference: The competitor keeps one even gap between its sections (beige FAQ band → contact → footer), with no section padded more than its neighbours.
findings.fix: In reference.css, remove `.block--related { padding-block: var(--section-space); }`, or limit it to a related section that opens its own tinted surface, so it takes the same section space as the blocks around it.

findings.issue: On phones the wide-variant factory photo keeps its desktop strip ratio (about 2.3:1). It shrinks to a band about 150px tall under a long run of text, too small to read (reported before; still unchanged).
findings.reference: The competitor's phone photos in text sections (the handover/mock-up image) run full width at a near-square or 4:3 ratio.
findings.fix: In reference.css at the stacked breakpoint, give the .block--split[data-variant="wide"] media aspect-ratio: 4 / 3 with object-fit: cover.

findings.issue: Two neighbouring sections of the same shape still stand one under the other: m7 'Mock-ups, Strike-offs and Sample Approval' and m8 'Print Lead Times, Pricing and Order Terms' both set their rows of short items as a list beside the heading.
findings.reference: Site rule: of two neighbouring sections made of short-item rows, the template sets only one of them as a list beside its heading.
findings.fix: When a process list and an iconList are neighbours, have the template give m8 the other iconList arrangement (items in columns under the heading).

findings.issue: After the photo band, m12 (proof), owner-testimonials and related all still sit on white, so three neighbouring plain sections do not alternate (at both widths).
findings.reference: The competitor alternates beige and white or navy bands from section to section. Site rule: the template alternates white and --section-tint between neighbouring plain sections.
findings.fix: Include testimonials and relatedPages blocks in the template's white/tint alternation so the run reads white, tint, white.

findings.issue: On phones the comparison table still cuts its fourth column ('Pigment with white underlayer', 'Digital pigment printing') off at the right edge, hinted only by a faint edge shadow, even after the narrower cell inset.
findings.reference: On phones the competitor shows comparisons as stacked panels (the 'Plain colours' / 'Prints' cards), with nothing cut off sideways.
findings.fix: Give the prose comparison chart (.prose__chart[data-chart="comparison"]) a stacked phone layout: one card per column, its rows as label/value pairs, instead of the sideways scroll.
